exposure: FIGO grading of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders (placenta previa, grade 1, grade 2, grade 3)
outcome: Differences in serum PLGF and sFlt-1 levels across PAS grades
Differences in placental PLGF and sFlt-1 expression across PAS grades
Correlation between serum levels and placental tissue expression of PLGF and sFlt-1
cohort: Sixty women with placenta previa and placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders (including FIGO grades 1, 2, and 3) undergoing surgery at Dr. Soetomo Hospital.
finding: The study found differences in PAS's angiogenic processes according to the severity of trophoblast cell invasion, but no overall correlation between serum levels and placental tissue expression of PLGF and sFlt-1, suggesting local mechanisms of angiogenic imbalance.
